_comment: Tunable policy + heuristics for the estimate phase (the knobs an org adjusts independently of the cost algorithm). KNOWLEDGE per docs/unit-taxonomy-spec.md. Rates live in aws-pricing.json; output SHAPE in schemas/estimation-infra.schema.json.

pricing_source._comment: The DSL has no guaranteed network at tool time. Cached rates (aws-pricing.json) are the DEFAULT and the deterministic path. IF an awspricing MCP is available the LLM MAY refresh stale/missing rates; record pricing_source per service. This is the faithful adaptation of upstream's cache-vs-live hierarchy.

hierarchy.when: rate NOT in cache AND MCP available
MCP attempted+failed, rate IS in cache
NOT in cache AND MCP failed/absent

pricing_source.staleness: if cache _meta.last_updated > staleness_days old, set status cached_stale + note (infra rates still reliable).
pricing_source.note: For typical heroku->aws (Fargate/RDS/Aurora/ElastiCache/ALB/NAT/MSK/S3/CloudWatch/SES/EventBridge/OpenSearch/MQ) ALL rates are cached -> zero MCP calls needed; the cached path is fully deterministic and is what the cold-test exercises.

tiers._comment: Three pricing SCENARIOS for the SAME architecture (not three stacks). Balanced is the primary; generated Terraform aligns with Balanced. ROUNDING: round each tier monthly to 2dp, THEN multiply by 12 for annual (round-then-multiply) so stored monthly and annual reconcile.

balanced.desc: on-demand, Multi-AZ where configured, standard monitoring

premium.desc: highest resilience, latest-gen, no Spot, enhanced monitoring

optimized.desc: reserved/Spot assumption ~30% discount, S3-IA cold data

tiers._premium_note: 1.5x and 0.7x are scenario factors applied to the balanced total for the headline tier figures; per-service breakdown is computed at balanced.

observability._comment: CloudWatch observability is added ONCE post-loop (like NAT), replacing any per-service CloudWatch-Logs entry — never double-count. Log volume is heuristic (Heroku's logging model differs, so billing data doesn't apply).
observability._log_volume_note: Counted PER DESIGNED SERVICE (not per running task / desired_count); msk is per broker. A CloudWatch Logs design service contributes 0 here — it is the log sink, subsumed into this block.
observability.formula: log_ingestion = sum(log_gb)*0.50; log_storage = sum(log_gb)*0.03*retention_months; metrics = custom_metrics*0.30; alarms = alarm_count*0.10; tracing = 0 unless tracing detected; total = sum

complexity_tiers._comment: Evaluate Large -> Medium -> Small, first match wins.

optimization_catalog._comment: Include ONLY opportunities relevant to the designed architecture.

database_savings_plans.alternative: RDS Reserved Instances up to 69% (locked to family/region)

recommendation_logic.migrate_optimized: AWS cheaper OR operational benefits justify
recommendation_logic.stay: AWS more expensive AND cost is the sole metric
non_cost_benefits: enterprise integration (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Organizations)

migration_cost_note.billing_available: Heroku platform fees during parallel operation (both running during cutover). Subscription-based; no Heroku egress fees.
migration_cost_note.billing_unavailable: Parallel-operation costs depend on Heroku billing. Provide invoices for dual-run projections.
